en.headline: Transport Department warns of busier roads on first school day
en.dek: Rail, bus, ferry and taxi operators have been told to add services on Tuesday if needed, while the department's emergency centre will run at its highest tier.
body: The Transport Department said overall road traffic is expected to be busier on Tuesday, when most schools begin the new term, and advised students to leave earlier to avoid delays. Motorists were told to avoid driving into school areas where possible.

The department said it has reminded major public transport operators, including railways, franchised buses, ferries and taxis, to provide adequate services and to increase frequencies and deploy standby trains, vehicles, vessels and staff when necessary. Special routes serving school districts will resume, and local franchised buses and cross-boundary coaches linking land boundary control points have been told to keep enough capacity for cross-boundary students.

On Tuesday morning the department's Emergency Transport Co-ordination Centre will operate in Joint Steering Mode, its highest tier, together with the police and major operators. Staff will be posted at major interchanges, stations, land crossings, tunnels and school areas including Braemar Hill in North Point, Kowloon Tong, Po Kong Village Road in Wong Tai Sin and Kwai Shing Circuit in Kwai Chung.

Students, especially those starting at a new school, were asked to learn their routes and frequencies in advance and to use pedestrian crossings properly. The department said it has also asked relevant offices to review road works on major routes so that disruption at the start of term can be kept down.

zh.headline: 運輸署料開學日交通較繁忙 緊急中心明早最高級別運作
zh.dek: 署方已提醒鐵路、專營巴士、渡輪及的士提供充足服務，有需要時加密班次；緊急事故交通協調中心明早會以聯合督導模式運作。
body: 運輸署表示，星期二大部分學校開學，當日整體路面交通預計會較繁忙，呼籲學生預早出門以免延誤，駕駛人士應盡量避免駛車前往學校區。
署方已提醒鐵路、專營巴士、渡輪及的士等主要公共運輸營辦商提供充足服務，並在有需要時加密班次及調配後備列車、車輛、船隻和人手。服務學校區的特別路線將恢復，接駁陸路口岸的本地專營巴士及跨境巴士亦已獲提醒，為跨境學生提供足夠服務。
運輸署緊急事故交通協調中心星期二上午會提升至最高級別的聯合督導模式，聯同警方及主要營辦商實時監察交通及公共交通情況。署方會派人到主要交匯處、車站、陸路口岸、隧道及學校區實地監察，包括北角寶馬山、九龍塘、黃大仙蒲崗村道及葵涌葵盛圍。
署方呼籲學生，尤其是轉校或入讀新校的學生，盡快熟習往返路線及班次，過路時正確使用行人過路設施。署方亦已要求相關部門檢視主要道路工程，盡量減低新學年初期對交通的影響。
